tspan.tspan: Example: a 4 s clip = 64,000 samples at 16 kHz. Brackets show tensor shapes [batch, …]; parameter counts are measured on the local xlsr_1b.ckpt.
16 kHz mono waveform, zero mean, unit variance
each frame sees 25 ms, hop 20 ms (about 50 frames/s)
Conv1d (kernel 128, 16 groups) → GELU, added to the input
plus one final LayerNorm after layer 48
19.68 M parameters per layer × 48 = 944.52 M, 98% of all 962.5 M. The
checkpoint holds 3.0 M more that only pre-training uses (quantizer etc.),
Blue: XLS-R (pre-trained by Meta, fully updated in NII's post-training).
Orange: the head added by NII.
